mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_schedule_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProFeedbackStatusEnum@APPROVING.status}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(COALESCE(total_quantity, quantity, 0)), 0) FROM mes_pro_schedule_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ( ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@SCHEDULED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@IN_PROGRESS.status} )

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(order_reported.reported_quantity), 0) FROM ( SELECT so.id, GREATEST( IFNULL(MAX(sop.reported_quantity), 0), IFNULL(MAX(feedback_by_order.feedback_quantity), 0) ) AS reported_quantity FROM mes_pro_schedule_order so LEFT JOIN mes_pro_schedule_order_process sop ON sop.schedule_order_id = so.id AND sop.deleted = 0 AND sop.enabled = b'1' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_order_id, MAX(feedback_quantity) AS feedback_quantity FROM mes_pro_feedback WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY schedule_order_id ) feedback_by_order ON feedback_by_order.schedule_order_id = so.id WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.status IN ( ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@SCHEDULED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@IN_PROGRESS.status} ) GROUP BY so.id ) order_reported

SELECT so.id AS scheduleOrderId, sop.id AS scheduleOrderProcessId, so.code AS scheduleOrderCode, so.erp_work_order_code AS workOrderCode, process.code AS processCode, process.name AS processName, COALESCE(sop.planned_quantity, so.total_quantity, so.quantity, 0) AS plannedQuantity, COALESCE(sop.reported_quantity, 0) AS reportedQuantity, COALESCE(sop.reported_quantity, 0) - COALESCE(sop.planned_quantity, so.total_quantity, so.quantity, 0) AS deviationQuantity, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sop.reported_quantity, 0) >= COALESCE(sop.planned_quantity, so.total_quantity, so.quantity, 0) THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN COALESCE(sop.reported_quantity, 0) > 0 THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'NOT_STARTED' END AS processStatus FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process sop JOIN mes_pro_schedule_order so ON so.id = sop.schedule_order_id AND so.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process process ON process.id = sop.process_id AND process.deleted = 0 WHERE sop.deleted = 0 AND sop.enabled = b'1' AND so.status IN ( ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@SCHEDULED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@IN_PROGRESS.status} ) ORDER BY so.id ASC, sop.sort ASC, sop.id ASC

SELECT route_summary.route_id, route_summary.route_code, route_summary.route_name, route_summary.wip_order_count, product_summary.product_id, product_summary.product_code, product_summary.product_name, product_summary.product_wip_order_count FROM ( SELECT so.route_id, route.code AS route_code, route.name AS route_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS wip_order_count FROM mes_pro_schedule_order so LEFT JOIN mes_pro_route route ON route.id = so.route_id AND route.deleted = 0 WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.status IN ( ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@PREPARE.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@SCHEDULED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@IN_PROGRESS.status} ) AND so.frozen = b'0' AND so.route_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process sop WHERE sop.deleted = 0 AND sop.enabled = b'1' AND sop.schedule_order_id = so.id AND (sop.progress_percent IS NULL OR sop.progress_percent < 100) ) GROUP BY so.route_id, route.code, route.name ) route_summary LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.route_id, so.product_id, item.code AS product_code, item.name AS product_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.id) AS product_wip_order_count FROM mes_pro_schedule_order so LEFT JOIN mes_md_item item ON item.id = so.product_id AND item.deleted = 0 WHERE so.deleted = 0 AND so.status IN ( ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@PREPARE.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@SCHEDULED.status}, ${@cn.iocoder.yudao.module.mes.enums.pro.MesProScheduleOrderStatusEnum@IN_PROGRESS.status} ) AND so.frozen = b'0' AND so.route_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process sop WHERE sop.deleted = 0 AND sop.enabled = b'1' AND sop.schedule_order_id = so.id AND (sop.progress_percent IS NULL OR sop.progress_percent < 100) ) GROUP BY so.route_id, so.product_id, item.code, item.name ) product_summary ON product_summary.route_id = route_summary.route_id ORDER BY route_summary.wip_order_count DESC, route_summary.route_code ASC, product_summary.product_wip_order_count DESC, product_summary.product_code ASC

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(IFNULL(process_snapshot.shift_capacity_total, 0)), 0) FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process process_snapshot WHERE process_snapshot.deleted = 0 AND process_snapshot.enabled = b'1' AND process_snapshot.capacity_source IS NOT NULL AND process_snapshot.capacity_source != 'UNCONFIGURED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_task_schedule_ext task_ext JOIN mes_pro_task task ON task.id = task_ext.task_id AND task.deleted = 0 AND task.start_time >= #{beginTime} AND task.start_time < #{endTime} WHERE task_ext.deleted = 0 AND task_ext.schedule_order_process_id = process_snapshot.id )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT machinery_id) FROM mes_dv_repair WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN (0, 1, 2)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process WHERE deleted = 0 AND enabled = b'1' AND (capacity_source IS NULL OR capacity_source = 'UNCONFIGURED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_pro_schedule_issue WHERE deleted = 0 AND issue_type = 'MATERIAL' AND severity = 'WARNING' AND create_time >= #{beginTime} AND create_time < #{endTime}

SELECT process_snapshot.id AS scheduleOrderProcessId, schedule_order.route_id AS routeId, process_snapshot.route_process_id AS routeProcessId, schedule_order.code AS scheduleOrderCode, schedule_order.erp_work_order_code AS workOrderCode, process.code AS processCode, process.name AS processName, NULL AS workstationName, process_snapshot.capacity_source AS resourceType, IFNULL(process_snapshot.planned_quantity, 0) AS demandQuantity, IFNULL(process_snapshot.reported_quantity, 0) AS scheduledQuantity, IFNULL(process_snapshot.remaining_quantity, 0) AS gapQuantity, 0 AS todayCapacity, CASE WHEN process_snapshot.capacity_source IS NULL OR process_snapshot.capacity_source = 'UNCONFIGURED' THEN '资源未配置' WHEN process_snapshot.bottleneck_flag = b'1' THEN '瓶颈工序' WHEN IFNULL(process_snapshot.remaining_quantity, 0) > 0 THEN '剩余数量未完成' ELSE '待复盘' END AS reason, CONCAT('/mes/pro/route/edit/', schedule_order.route_id, '?tab=schedule-config&routeProcessId=', process_snapshot.route_process_id) AS targetPath FROM mes_pro_schedule_order_process process_snapshot JOIN mes_pro_schedule_order schedule_order ON schedule_order.id = process_snapshot.schedule_order_id AND schedule_order.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_pro_process process ON process.id = process_snapshot.process_id AND process.deleted = 0 WHERE process_snapshot.deleted = 0 AND process_snapshot.enabled = b'1' AND (process_snapshot.bottleneck_flag = b'1' OR IFNULL(process_snapshot.remaining_quantity, 0) > 0 OR process_snapshot.capacity_source IS NULL OR process_snapshot.capacity_source = 'UNCONFIGURED') ORDER BY process_snapshot.bottleneck_flag DESC, process_snapshot.remaining_quantity DESC LIMIT 10
